extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: KodiConnectForSilo writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; KodiConnectForSilo manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.29.0: Live TV as Sky Stream (Skyline 0.21.0): the TV guide's Restart what's on now row plays a programme from its start; Left/Right rewind or fast-forward 10 s (held, 5 min) unless the banner is up; the banner shows the next two programmes. The Start from the beginning note on tuning in is gone.
0.28.0: TV page (Skyline 0.20.0): a Coming up live row of live events starting in the next 12 hours (not news), soonest first; OK sets a reminder. A long press on a recent channel removes it again, on the TV page and on the OK screen while a channel plays.
0.27.1: tidy-up: the mini guide's leftover code is gone (Skyline 0.19.2 drops its window).
0.27.0: the TV guide (Skyline 0.19.0, Sky Stream's look) shows the focused programme's channel logo at its top.
0.26.1: Start from the beginning is offered once when a channel starts playing, not again on coming back from the TV guide; Back dismisses it (Skyline 0.18.1).
0.26.0: Live TV, as Sky's (needs Skyline 0.18.0): Left and Right step the banner through the channel's earlier and later programmes; OK watches one from catch-up or sets a reminder. Tuning in partway through a programme on a catch-up channel offers to start it from the beginning, and Coming up next shows near a programme's end. The TV page has Recent channels, then a row for each of the guide's groups. Hold OK for the TV guide; the quick guide and mini guide are gone.
